title: AFTERIMAGE//PULSE V2
description: DaemonV12 Sound Lab 03, V2: 28 bars of melodic garage-bass, E major, 136 BPM. THRONE//VOLT, Living Bass, Impossible Voice, HEAVEN//MASS, Mechanical Orchestra, Timbre Lab; V12 Signature and GLASSHOUSE drums.

tracks.description: V12 IRON PULSE body + GLASSHOUSE bass-punch knock; displaced in the groove, on every pickup in the cascade.
V12 TITANIUM CRACK +1 st + GLASSHOUSE chrome clap; 5-8 ms late; one dragged backbeat; ghosts.
GLASSHOUSE pixel hat, V12 ghost tick and open circuit; accent patterns that change bar to bar; drifting pan.
Timbre Lab hollow log and hand skin (fill, heartbeat), escapement clock (the glitch canon's ticks).
The afterimage: Mechanical Orchestra bar; the opening, the memory under the choir, the ending.
Living Bass below 120 Hz: mono, ducked under every kick.
Living Bass above 120 Hz: the talking body and the melodic bass, saturated for small speakers.
Impossible Voice: the glitch passage, with the bass; the cry into the afterimage.
THRONE//VOLT: the hook, dark, talking, full voice; the cascade; the resolution.
THRONE//VOLT pad: the chord bed, breathing in the hook rhythm.
HEAVEN//MASS basses (octavists on the C major bloom) and tenors; payoff roots and the last chord.
HEAVEN//MASS altos and sopranos: the half-speed hook and the G that lifts; the payoff descant.
The shared rack room (wet only) of the lead, pad, voice/bass and percussion scores.
